answer: Entropy-Gated Registration Windows. Each identity slot opens at a beacon-derived random time on a shared ferrous clock; agents must submit within that window or forfeit. Windows are drawn from a verifiable delay function, so attackers cannot precompute slot schedules and must keep workers idle across every terrace of the calendar. A timber-signed commitment binds each submission to one slot. Cost: continuous idle infrastructure plus missed-window waste, scaling with attempted clones rather than with stake.
